purpose: Four Spanish Mexico campaign image concepts

specs.label: 쇼핑 전 · 남은 예산 확인
specs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete polished portrait 4:5 social advertising concept image for Sobrita, a free manual expense tracking and quincena budgeting Android app for Mexico with cute pixel pets. This is a brand campaign mockup for November shopping season. Spanish Mexico language only in the image. The image must feel art-directed, adorable, premium indie app, highly readable at mobile size. NOT a webpage, NOT a strategy diagram, NOT a collage of multiple ads.
Reference roles: existing Sobrita advertisement = brand palette/type/illustration direction only; sprite sheet(s) = exact character identities only, render each character once, never reproduce the sheet. Any app screenshot reference = visual language only; never copy the old name "Sobra". Brand name always "Sobrita".
Preserve Michi's exact identity: navy-blue kitten, three cream forehead strokes, cream muzzle/chest/paw tips/tail tip, amber eyes, teal collar with gold square buckle, one ear softly folded. Charming detailed pixel-art texture consistent with the existing ad, crisp silhouette, not 3D or photoreal. Large bold friendly rounded sans typography for headline, generous whitespace, clean text without pixel-font distortion. Small pixel stars/paws only as restrained accents.
Layout: 7% safe margin, top brand wordmark "Sobrita" and small campaign eyebrow, big upper-third headline with natural Spanish line breaks, one dominant central illustration, short subcopy and clear CTA near bottom. All lettering must match verbatim, accents correct. No official Buen Fin or retailer logos, no fake sale price or discount percentages, no bank logos, no money-growth promise, no QR code, no app store badge, no watermark. No extraneous text.
Concept 1 PRE-SHOPPING. Mint-green and warm ivory palette, navy text, teal accents. Calm optimistic editorial composition. Large friendly Michi sits beside a simple illustrated cream budget card and one modest peach shopping bag. Paw gestures toward remaining budget before shopping. This is an editorial illustration of the app's budget concept, not a literal fake app screenshot. One prominent legible card shows the exact text "Hoy te queda" and "MX$250", with a simple teal horizontal bar. Small card footnote "Ejemplo". Keep card secondary to headline and Michi. A few pixel sparkles, no clutter.
Exact typography:
Top wordmark: "Sobrita"
Eyebrow: "ANTES DE LAS OFERTAS"
Headline: "Antes de comprar,\nmira cuánto te queda."
Subcopy: "Tu presupuesto, a la vista."
CTA inside a solid teal pill: "Conoce Sobrita"
Footer: "Gastos y presupuesto · Android"

Show ONE Michi happily welcoming ONE Miru through an open cozy mint doorway. Two real starters, no other animal, no gift box, no costume. Below or beside them, three attractive little calendar-style cards labeled only "1", "2", "3", each with a teal check mark, linked loosely with pixel pawprints, NOT consecutive date calendar and NOT expense count. They represent three distinct days with records. No reward for shopping, no real money reward.
Exact typography:
Top wordmark: "Sobrita"
Eyebrow: "RETO DE REGISTRO"
Headline: "3 días,\nun nuevo amigo."
Subcopy: "Registra tus gastos en 3 días distintos."
CTA inside solid teal pill: "Empieza hoy con Sobrita"
Readable small eligibility footer: "Desbloquea al compañero inicial que aún no tienes."
